author: J.R. Farrar
releaseNotes:
1.0.3 - first release. Watches each Garadget's 'health' (needs Garadget MQTT Driver 1.4.6+) and, when a unit is offline, its sensor has frozen, or an open/close was not confirmed, power-cycles that Garadget through its own smart outlet, proves it restarted, and notifies what it now sees: ALERT if the door is actually open, INFO otherwise, and 'back to normal' when health clears. One child app per door.
Safety: never moves a door (it only switches the Garadget's power); never acts while a door is moving or within 5 min of a move; at most 2 power cycles per 24 h and per problem, then a single 'NEEDS YOU' alert; never leaves the outlet off (restored on hub start, by timer and by a 30-minute check); a stopped door whose reading moved is treated as a physical problem and not power-cycled. Notify-only mode available. The outlet must power ONLY the Garadget, never the opener.
